evidence_items.locator: Evaluation of LLMs on the Blocksworld domain, discussion of GPT-4
evidence_items.explanation: Executable-plan checks expose substantial failures in a defined reasoning task. The paper also finds improvements over older models and benefits from external planners and verification, limiting any inference that LLM-assisted reasoning is invariably unreliable.
